points.title: 童年与教育启蒙
points.description: 理查德·费曼于1918年5月11日出生于纽约市皇后区的一个犹太家庭。他的父亲梅尔维尔·费曼是一位制服商人，对科学有着浓厚兴趣，经常鼓励小费曼思考问题。在法罗卡温斯区的公立学校就读期间，费曼展现出非凡的数学天赋，自学了微积分。这段时期，他培养了独立思考的习惯和对科学的好奇心，父亲教导他的'质疑权威'和'理解事物本质'的理念成为他一生的重要信条。
points.descriptionEn: Richard Feynman was born on May 11, 1918, in Far Rockaway, Queens, New York City, to a Jewish family. His father, Melville Feynman, a uniform salesman, fostered Richard's interest in science by encouraging him to think critically. During his schooling in public schools, Feynman displayed exceptional mathematical talent, teaching himself calculus. This period shaped his independent thinking and scientific curiosity, with his father's lessons on questioning authority and understanding the essence of things becoming lifelong principles.

points.title: 大学深造
points.description: 费曼进入麻省理工学院学习，最初选择主修数学，但后来转向物理。在MIT期间，他参与了著名的'实验物理'课程，并开始发展自己独特的物理直觉和解决问题的方法。1939年，他以优异成绩毕业，并获得了普林斯顿大学的奖学金。在MIT的最后一年，他完成了第一个重要研究项目，关于量子力学中的力矩问题，这为他后来的量子电动力学研究奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Feynman attended MIT, initially majoring in mathematics before switching to physics. During his time at MIT, he participated in the famous 'experimental physics' course and began developing his unique physical intuition and problem-solving methods. In 1939, he graduated with high honors and received a scholarship to Princeton University. In his final year at MIT, he completed his first significant research project on torque in quantum mechanics, laying the foundation for his later work on quantum electrodynamics.

points.title: 研究生阶段
points.description: 在普林斯顿大学，费曼在约翰·惠勒的指导下攻读博士学位，开始深入研究量子力学。他提出了'路径积分'方法，这是对量子力学的一种全新表述方式。1941年，他获得了博士学位，论文主题是'量子力学中的最小作用量原理'。在普林斯顿期间，他还参与了早期的原子能研究，并结识了爱因斯坦等著名物理学家。这段经历极大地拓展了他的学术视野，并为他后来参与曼哈顿计划埋下了伏笔。
points.descriptionEn: At Princeton University, Feynman pursued his doctorate under John Wheeler's guidance, delving deep into quantum mechanics. He developed the 'path integral' approach, a novel formulation of quantum mechanics. In 1941, he earned his Ph.D. with a thesis on 'The Principle of Least Action in Quantum Mechanics.' During his time at Princeton, he also participated in early atomic energy research and met renowned physicists like Albert Einstein. This experience significantly broadened his academic perspective and set the stage for his later involvement in the Manhattan Project.

points.title: 曼哈顿计划
points.description: 二战期间，费曼作为理论物理学家加入曼哈顿计划，在新墨西哥州的洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室工作。他被分配到罗伯特·奥本海默的团队，负责计算原子弹的临界质量。费曼以其卓越的计算能力和创新思维解决了许多复杂问题。在洛斯阿拉莫斯期间，他发展了'费曼图'这一强大的可视化工具，用于简化复杂的粒子相互作用计算。这段经历不仅提升了他的物理学造诣，也让他对科学的社会责任有了更深刻的认识。
points.descriptionEn: During World War II, Feynman joined the Manhattan Project as a theoretical physicist, working at the Los Alamos National Laboratory in New Mexico. Assigned to Robert Oppenheimer's team, he calculated critical masses for the atomic bomb. Feynman solved numerous complex problems with his exceptional computational skills and innovative thinking. During his time at Los Alamos, he developed the 'Feynman diagrams,' a powerful visualization tool for simplifying calculations of complex particle interactions. This experience not only enhanced his physics expertise but also deepened his understanding of science's social responsibilities.

points.title: 学术巅峰与晚年
points.description: 1950年，费曼加入加州理工学院，开始了长达38年的教学生涯。在这里，他完成了量子电动力学的革命性工作，因'对量子电动力学的基础性工作，包括对基本粒子物理学的深刻见解'而获得1965年诺贝尔物理学奖。费曼还是挑战者号航天飞机事故调查委员会的关键成员，以其著名的'O型环'实验展示了低温下橡胶的弹性失效问题。晚年，他致力于推广科学教育，发展了'费曼学习法'，并出版了多本畅销科普著作，包括《费曼物理学讲义》和《别闹了，费曼先生》。1988年，费曼因腹膜间皮瘤去世，享年69岁。
points.descriptionEn: In 1950, Feynman joined Caltech, beginning a 38-year teaching career. Here, he completed his revolutionary work on quantum electrodynamics, earning the 1965 Nobel Prize in Physics 'for fundamental work in quantum electrodynamics, with deep-ploughing consequences for the physics of elementary particles.' Feynman also served as a key member of the Challenger space shuttle disaster investigation committee, famously demonstrating the O-ring failure at low temperatures with his 'ice water' experiment. In his later years, he devoted himself to science education, developing the 'Feynman Learning Technique,' and published several popular science books, including 'The Feynman Lectures on Physics' and 'Surely You're Joking, Mr. Feynman!' Feynman died in 1988 at age 69 from abdominal mesothelioma.

appraisal.zh: 费曼通常被视为20世纪最重要的物理学家之一，其量子电动力学工作与费曼图已成为物理学的标准工具，他在《费曼物理学讲义》中展现的教学才能和对科学普及的投入同样影响深远。不过也有研究者指出，他一方面倡导科学理性，一方面参与曼哈顿计划制造核武器，其自信有时近乎傲慢，路径积分方法亦曾被批评不够严谨，公众形象存在被过度神话之嫌。他既是核武器的制造者，又是核裁军运动的参与者，这种复杂性构成其遗产的一部分。
appraisal.en: Feynman is generally regarded as one of the foremost physicists of the 20th century, whose work in quantum electrodynamics and his Feynman diagrams became standard tools of the field, while his teaching in 'The Feynman Lectures on Physics' and his commitment to science communication proved equally influential. Yet some researchers note the tension between his advocacy of scientific rationality and his role in the Manhattan Project, a confidence that at times verged on arrogance, and a path integral method once faulted for insufficient rigor; his public image, they add, has been overly mythologized. Both a maker of nuclear weapons and a participant in disarmament efforts, he embodied a complexity that remains part of his legacy.

supporter.zh: 费曼被科学界誉为20世纪最伟大的物理学家之一，他的量子电动力学理论彻底改变了物理学。支持者赞扬他独特的教学风格和将复杂概念简单化的能力，认为他代表了科学精神的典范——好奇、质疑、创新。费曼不仅推动了理论物理学的发展，还通过《费曼物理学讲义》等著作影响了无数学生，他对科学普及的贡献同样不可忽视。他的'费曼学习法'至今仍被广泛推崇，体现了真正的学习本质。
supporter.en: Feynman is regarded by supporters as one of the greatest physicists of the 20th century, whose quantum electrodynamics theory revolutionized physics. They praise his unique teaching style and ability to simplify complex concepts, seeing him as an embodiment of the scientific spirit—curious, questioning, and innovative. Feynman not only advanced theoretical physics but also influenced countless students through works like 'The Feynman Lectures on Physics.' His contributions to science communication are equally significant, and his 'Feynman Learning Technique' remains widely celebrated, embodying the true essence of learning.

critic.zh: 批评者指出费曼在个人生活中存在矛盾，一方面倡导科学理性，另一方面却参与曼哈顿计划制造核武器。有人认为他过于自信甚至傲慢，有时忽视他人的贡献。在科学方法论上，他的路径积分方法虽然强大，但也被批评为不够严谨。此外，费曼对挑战者号事故的调查虽然精彩，但也有人质疑其简化复杂工程问题的做法。批评者认为，费曼的公众形象有时被过度神话，掩盖了他作为科学家的局限性和复杂性。
critic.en: Critics point out contradictions in Feynman's personal life—advocating for scientific rationality while participating in the Manhattan Project to create nuclear weapons. Some argue he was overly confident or arrogant, sometimes neglecting to acknowledge others' contributions. Scientifically, while his path integral method was powerful, it was criticized for lacking rigor. Additionally, though his Challenger investigation was brilliant, some question his approach of simplifying complex engineering problems. Critics suggest that Feynman's public image has been overly mythologized, obscuring his limitations and complexities as a scientist.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，费曼被定义为一位多才多艺的科学奇才和反叛者。他既是严谨的理论物理学家，又是充满魅力的公众人物；既参与最前沿的科学研究，又热衷于开锁、绘画、演奏邦戈鼓等看似无关的活动。费曼已成为科学普及的象征，他的故事被广泛传播，激励着无数年轻人投身科学。在物理学界，他的费曼图已成为标准工具，而他的科学方法论影响了多个领域。然而，历史评价也承认他的复杂性——他既是核武器的制造者，又是核裁军运动的参与者；既是权威的挑战者，又是学术精英的一员。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Feynman is defined as a versatile scientific prodigy and rebel. He was both a rigorous theoretical physicist and a charismatic public figure; engaged in cutting-edge research while pursuing seemingly unrelated hobbies like safecracking, painting, and playing the bongo drums. Feynman has become a symbol of science communication, with his story widely inspiring young people to pursue science. In physics, his Feynman diagrams have become standard tools, and his scientific methodology has influenced multiple fields. However, historical evaluations also acknowledge his complexity—he was both a creator of nuclear weapons and a participant in the nuclear disarmament movement; both an authority challenger and a member of the academic elite.

self.zh: 我认为我能安全地说，没有人真正理解量子力学。
self.en: I think I can safely say that nobody understands quantum mechanics.
